moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is set to begin on Friday, August 21st, with fixtures already released, marking the start of a new campaign.

angles.name: Kick-off Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off on August 21st. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Team Predictions

angles.name: Local Club Buzz

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Shield
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage! The Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield this Sunday, August 16th, as Arsenal face Manchester City. Get ready for a Welsh football spectacle!

angles.name: Big Game in Wales
angles.copy: The first silverware of the season is up for grabs this Sunday! Arsenal vs Manchester City in the Community Shield, live from Cardiff.

angles.name: Principality Stadium Buzz
angles.copy: Principality Stadium is buzzing for the Community Shield this weekend! Who are you rooting for, Arsenal or Man City?

moments.title: FIH Hockey World Cup 2026 Starts
moments.blurb: The FIH Hockey World Cup 2026 kicks off on August 15th in Belgium and the Netherlands, with free-to-air coverage of all England, Scotland, and Wales matches on Channel 4 Sport YouTube.

angles.name: Hockey World Cup Free
angles.copy: Get ready for world-class hockey! The FIH Hockey World Cup starts August 15th, and you can watch England, Scotland, and Wales matches FREE on Channel 4 Sport YouTube!

angles.name: England vs Wales Hockey

moments.title: London Submits 2029 World Athletics Bid
moments.blurb: London has today submitted its final bid to host the 2029 World Athletics Championships, with an agreement reached for the use of the London Stadium.

angles.name: London Bids for Athletics
angles.copy: Big news for UK sport! London has officially submitted its final bid to host the 2029 World Athletics Championships. Fingers crossed!

angles.name: Stadium Agreement Reached
angles.copy: It's official: London Stadium is good to go! A deal has been struck for its use in the capital's bid to host the 2029 World Athletics Championships.

angles.name: West Ham Stadium
angles.copy: Could the London Stadium host the World Athletics Championships in 2029? London's bid is in, with an agreement reached with West Ham for minimal impact on their season.

angles.name: Hip Hop & Culture

angles.name: Weekend Vibes

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents Series Continues
